reason: Gibbose is a spelling variant of gibbous (swollen on one side), already a FLOPO value with sepal, corolla and lip bearers.

label: resin-scented
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having the balsamic odour of resin.
reason: A distinct odour with no term. It goes beside FLOPO sweet-scented and spicy-scented. FLOPO:0991075 resinous means containing resin, not smelling of it.
Only the density is a quality of the covering. What clothes the part (hairs, scales) is a separate statement, as the previous review held for 'covered'.
'Sub-' softens dense (PATO_0001164) on the inflorescence, the same as suborbicular in the approximate-value pattern.
Two values run together: flattened (PATO_0002254) and orbicular (PATO_0001934). It needs a compound-value pattern, not a term.
A compound of attenuate (PATO_0001982) and cuneate (PATO_0001955) for a leaf base.
'Rosette-forming' is already listed as a synonym of FLOPO rosulate.
A tooth-shaped lobe or sepal is a small, pointed triangle. PATO_0001205 dentated (margin bearing teeth) is a different quality.

target: callus (no class yet; not PO_0005052 plant callus) absent
reason: It states that the lip or petal has no callus. PO_0005052 is wound tissue, so a FLOPO anatomy class for the floral callus is needed before this rule can apply.
A thickness given as a count of cell layers (one), on a leaf, lamina or margin.
Triangular (PATO_0001875) run together with rounded. For an achene cross-section it reads as FLOPO:0991120 trigonous.
A biglobose capsule or stigma is made of two globose lobes. 'Bilobed' keeps the two lobes but loses their roundness.
In 'disk florets' the word names the part; disk floret is a synonym of PO disk flower.
A vague count of capitula (or of caudex crowns), like 'few-flowered'.
'Internode' is the part, and its length is an ordinary measurement. Internodes of an inflorescence or rachis are internodes of that axis.
Quadrate laminal cells are square. 'Irregularly' only loosens the value (approximate-value pattern).
Bracts that look like leaflets are foliaceous, which the previous review mapped to PATO leaf-like.
Rufescent means reddish brown, the PATO term's exact synonym.

label: spathe-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a spathe, a large sheathing bract that encloses an inflorescence.
reason: Sibling of FLOPO:0991200 bract-like and PATO sepal-like; spathe (FLOPO_0986007) exists as a part but there is no 'like a spathe' value.

target: new: colour of a part of the bearer
reason: The colour applies to the apex: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) of the bearer + white (PATO_0000323). Colour-tipped terms for every colour would multiply.
'Appendage' is a generic part that was rejected as a bearer (config/flora_rejected_bearer_words.tsv), so an absence of it cannot be annotated.
Rostrate means beaked; the shortness belongs to the beak and can be added as its own length statement.
'Sub-' plus square (PATO_0000413), the same as suborbicular.
It places the widest point along the part (moss capsule urn, corolla). That is a position on an axis, not a shape term.

label: semi-aquatic
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing in wet places that are periodically or partly flooded, between aquatic and terrestrial habitats.
reason: Sits between FLOPO aquatic and terrestrial. FLOPO:0991193 emergent requires rooting in standing water, which these rock-dwelling plants do not show.
Bearing small appendages, a generic part that was already rejected as a bearer ('appendaged' is in the rejected list).
A count of carpels (PO_0009030): three.
A vague count of veins (several), like '5-nerved' in the count pattern.
A vague count of bracteoles (PO_0009043): many.

label: cyme-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture resembling a cyme, an inflorescence in which each axis ends in a flower and further flowers arise from lateral branches below it.
reason: Sibling of FLOPO raceme-like, panicle-like and thyrse-like; PO cyme inflorescence (PO_0030126) is the part, not the likeness.
